definitions: Third person singular simple present indicative form of tease.
To make fun of or attempt to provoke (a person or animal) in a playful or malicious way.
To comb (wool or other fibres) with a teasel or a machine designed for the purpose, in order to raise a nap.
examples: He often teas his little sister.
The machine teas the fabric to create a soft finish.
She teas her hair to add volume.
